rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and predictions before data; synthetic (gauge curve, churn null, power, S/S0 check); nine kickoff units in eight periods; two room natives (G44, G38); post-hoc design-code test (labelled); per-period estimates (20 rows); confirm.py frozen (#45, #46, #47, #49), not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The pre-registered gauge failed as a measurement (H54 name-token flags do not track specificity) and the primary test is underpowered (0.29). The post-hoc goal-type split is clean (5/5 vs 4/4, p 0.008) but post hoc and close to H75's earlier result. Scorecard A0 B1 C0 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Restates H75's kickoff rule on nine kickoffs: name or assign the artifact and the swarm settles in < 1 active h; open goals take 4-13 h. Useful and simple, but not new, and the slack is a read-out, not a lever.

one_line: Slack does not track the HH's specificity x (rho -0.01, n 9; x itself is invalid: word overlap, not specificity), but separates assigned-artifact goals (S 1.0-2.5, T_e < 1 h) from open goals (S 3-15, T_e 4-13 h) perfectly, post hoc (p 0.008).

v2.claim: Kickoff goal type sets re-allocation speed: goals that assign a concrete artifact settle at slack 1.0–2.5 within 0.25–0.75 active h, open goals at 3.0–14.5 over 4–13 h (Mann–Whitney p 0.008, 9 units); the pre-registered specificity measure x is invalid
v2.original_verdict: failed as posed (post hoc goal-type split)

ladder.factor: penalty: post hoc code, small n

v2.decision: give the swarm a concrete artifact in the kickoff to settle in under an hour

raters.claim: Across nine regime-III kickoff units, the post hoc goal-type code (goal assigns a concrete artifact vs open/objective-only) separates speed-limit slack perfectly: assigned S 1.0-2.5, T_e 0.25-0.75 h; open S 3.0-14.5, T_e 4-13 h (exact Mann-Whitney p 0.008). Excluded: the pre-registered x gauge (rho -0.01; invalid measure), P2-P5, N2.
ladder: partial replication (9/9 units consistent; G37, G38, G42 are new beyond H75's points)
partly robust (S and T_e both separate; p 0.004 with G36)
intervention partly consistent (G44 rooms, same days, assigned vs free: x5.8 slack; but the S values were already seen in H75)
penalty: goal-type coding chosen after the run by an analyst who had seen H75's S values; one holdout target (#47 #best) is disclosed to have frozen fast
